text: THE DOCUMENTATION SITE, THE EXPLORATIONS AND THE LANGUAGE PICKER BUILD EVERY CONTROL FROM THE DESIGN SYSTEM. 52 raw <button> elements are gone. The docs chrome: the menu and search triggers, the sidebar filter (now Search) and group toggles, the Design / Code / Accessibility tabs (now the design system's Tabs, which carry the keyboard model the page used to hand-write), the phone table of contents (now a SideSheet with a focus trap — the hand-built sheet had none), the command-palette clear, category filters and suggestions, the playground's density, language and code switches (attached ButtonGroups with aria-pressed; the Hindi option keeps lang="hi"), the copy buttons and the feedback bar. The foundation pages: the colour page's brand bar, the typography surface picker (card RadioGroup) and property tabs, and the icon catalogue's tiles. The exploration viewer's option tabs, steps and reset, and every band's dismiss, play and slide controls. The language dialog now opens at the large size: at the medium one its second column overflowed and was cut off. Five bare buttons remain on purpose — the Density and States specimens, which show what the tokens alone do — and each declares raw-button-ok(specimen).
